tha-ap200:1.1: Muṭṭhipūjaka.] Sumedho nāma bhagavā lokajeṭṭho narāsabho / pacchime anukampāya padhānaṃ padahī jino. // //
tha-ap200:2.1: Tassa ca kampamānassa dipadindassa tādino / girinelassa pupphānaṃ muṭṭhiṃ Buddhass' aropayiṃ // //
tha-ap200:3.1: Tena cittappasādena sukkamūlena codito / tiṃsakappasahassāni duggatiṃ nūpapajj' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap200:4.1: Tevīsatikappasate Sunelo nāma khattiyo / sattaratanasampanno eko āsi mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap200:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Muṭṭhipūjako thero i. g. a-ti.
